column1: # Hosts that tracker SDKs send to, graded by what each host does (W8 part 3a). Compiled by the Datapavan project from
# the SDKs' own documentation and source at pinned commits, Tweasel's CC0 tracker wiki and vendors' firewall lists;
# no row is copied from a blocklist and no εxodus data is in this file (LICENSE, SOURCE).
#  host       DNS name; matches itself and every name under it (label boundary)
#  sdk        Maven group:artifact of the SDK whose code or docs name the host (for Facebook, the artifact that holds
#             the constant, facebook-core, whatever feature uses it)
#  classes    Java package prefix of the SDK feature that sends there; joins the row at run time to the εxodus tracker
#             whose code signature names the same SDK (a signature alternative is a prefix of it, or it of one)
#  grade      block (only tracking, analytics, attribution, ads, crash or performance reporting), keep (also serves the
#             app's own function), code (serves both; the condition decides from the app's code)
#  condition  - for block and keep; for code: block-with P|P keep-with P|P (block when the app holds a block-with
#             prefix and none of the keep-with ones, keep otherwise)
#  evidence   docs, code (constant in the SDK's source at a pinned commit or tag), tweasel (endpoint page), firewall
#             (the vendor's own list of hosts to allow)
#  source     the page or the source line read
# Rows sorted by sdk, then host. Rows whose classes join no εxodus tracker (Firebase installations, Remote Config,
# GoogleDataTransport) are kept for their grade; coverage.py lists them.
